column9: Lions are big, strong cats with sandy brown colored fur. As boy lions mature, they grow longer hair around their head, neck, and chest which is called a mane. Lions make many sounds to talk with their family or to tell other lions that they are near. The loudest sound they make is a roar, which can be heard up to 5 miles away. Lionesses are skilled hunters with sharp teeth and claws who catch and eat animals for meat. Fossils show that lions have been living in Africa for around 2 million years! In the past lions roamed widely across Earth. Today, most lions live in Africa and part of India.
